answer: Agents bind identity to continuous hardware-timing attestations: each must produce a valid solution to a world-state-derived constraint puzzle within a microsecond window unique to their silicon latency fingerprint and network position; the puzzle binds to their private key and on-chip entropy, so forging a meadow of identities demands replicating each agent's exact physical timing profile — a voyage requiring per-sybil specialized hardware far exceeding token rewards, forcing attackers to wander through prohibitive CAPEX rather than rentable compute.
